evidence: Enriched features do not beat the static arm on held-out target-disease links
metric: macro AUROC 0.895 heuristic / 0.877 logistic enriched vs 0.895 static; F-0006
observation: Enriched features (ligand activity, PPI, GO) did not beat the static arm on held-out target-disease links, and the logistic model did slightly worse with them while the Adamic-Adar heuristic was unchanged because it sees only target-disease edges. The decision recorded was to stop claiming enrichment lift and treat the suite as a measurement pending an investigation of feature utility.
subject: F-5
title: F-0006: enrichment gives no lift over the static arm
